Explanations

  • Full methodology and scoring formulas explained in this article
  • Prices are calculated with API costs
  • When a model is tested via a subscription plan rather than the API, there's no per-prompt price to measure, so the avg cost column shows N/A for comparison
  • Below the API price, models we also tested on a $20/mo subscription show how much of the plan's weekly limit the 20 Edge-case Testing prompts used together, for example 9% / week. Providers show usage in whole percents, so <1% means the meter did not move. The 5-hour limit, $100 plans and token counts are on the Subscription Usage Limits page
